Lets give these things what they deserve!|audio = KorbloxTempleWave-6.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 6 ([[Korblox Temple]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Redcliff Traitor''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Hunt: Mega Edition Event]]. It also appears in [[The Classic Event]] missions as part of [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It has a high amount of health, higher than the [[Korblox Warrior (The Hunt: Mega Edition)|Korblox Warrior]], and a quick speed for its health, having the same speed as the [[Korblox Soul (The Hunt: Mega Edition)|Korblox Soul]]. ==Logbook Description== "''The Redcliff Traitor comprises both high ranking Korblox and Redcliff warriors. Forcibly merged by a powerful entity, there may be greater threats lurking in the shadows—dangers that both empires have yet to notice.''" ==Appearance== The '''Redcliff Traitor''' has tan and blue skin. It wears full body armor, which consists of a helmet, chestplate, leggings, shoulder-pads and shoes. This armor is split into two halves. The first half is based around the armor worn by the Redcliff faction, while the second by the Korblox faction. The Redcliff part is colored red and gold while the Korblox part is colored dark blue and grey. The Korblox part also has multiple dark blue and blue horns on it. The emblems of the two factions are also visible on its armor. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Korblox Temple]] is listed instead. *Multiple early-game towers, like the [[Militant]], [[Shotgunner]], [[Medic]] or [[Brawler]] can be useful against this. *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Turret]] or [[Accelerator]] can kill this quite quickly. *As the '''Redcliff Traitor''' has multiple immunities, it is significantly harder to slow down. **It cannot be frozen, chilled or knocked back by towers. Additionally, stuns only slow it down instead of fully stunning it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} RedcliffTraitorSprint.gif|Walking animation (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Redcliff.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseRedcliffTraitor.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} The Hunt- Mega Edition Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Redcliff Traitor''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} RedcliffTraitorIconIG.png|'''Redcliff Traitor''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Redcliff Traitor''' references the rivalry between the [[w:c:Roblox:Knights of RedCliff|Knights of RedCliff]] and [[w:c:Roblox:Korblox's Empire|Korblox's Empire]]. **Hstorically, members who defected to other factions, or were simply banished are called Renegades. ==Update History== *'''12 March 2025''' -
